segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I went with the analytics pass plus a light competitor scan, and deferred interviews.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The hidden zero-bias manifest requests zero Herding occurrences and no other intentional bias instance is present.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Analytics tells you where people drop, not always why. I flagged that trade-off to the team and kept research on standby.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant explicitly recognizes the limitation of the selected evidence and retains a fallback research option; the hidden zero-bias manifest has no instance here.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The sharper signal was abandonment right after the payment-detail field, concentrated in a newer account subgroup — about 140 users.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a qualified interpretation of incomplete cohort and heatmap evidence, not an intentionally embedded hidden bias instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The deal-specific requests gave me something concrete to point to ... I decided to build the guided setup wizard.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Decision point 2 was deliberately rewritten to use two named deal requests and a small internal cohort signal, preserving ambiguity without instantiating Herding or another hidden target.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I didn't go that route because it would have delayed a decision the deals needed answered, and because I felt the payment data alone wasn't strong enough.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant explains why a controlled comparison was rejected; no hidden occurrence is planned in this control interview.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I chose full reallocation rather than splitting time or delaying, because a split effort usually means both things ship late and half-tested.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a stated staffing trade-off with a plausible operational rationale and no hidden bias instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I chose full launch. A longer canary would not have given us clean results in time, and delaying meant showing up to the board with a plan instead of something shipped.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The launch decision is intentionally non-diagnostic in the hidden control manifest; time pressure and a risk trade-off do not establish a hidden bias.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We shifted focus afterward to a proper look at the payment validation and getting the instrumentation gap closed.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a corrective follow-up action based on post-launch evidence; the hidden manifest contains no planned instance.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The quote is valid and localizes to seg_004, but the supplied hidden manifest has zero instances and the control segment contains no Herding or other intentional bias instance. Salience bias is therefore an unsupported prediction for this interview, not a strict or mechanism-first match.

The candidate quote validly localizes to seg_007, but the supplied zero-bias manifest contains no hidden instance. The transcript supports legitimate time-pressure and release-risk explanations, so the candidate is not a ground-truth match.

candidates.details: The candidate is explicitly presented as insufficiently evidenced, and the supplied control manifest contains no intentional bias instance. It becomes a segment- and instance-level false positive only at the candidate-inclusive threshold.

high_only.detection_interpretation: No high-confidence identified findings were produced; all eight negative segments were correctly rejected.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: No high- or moderate-confidence identified findings were produced; all eight negative segments were correctly rejected.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: The low-confidence Salience bias finding creates one false alarm in the zero-bias control; seven segments remain correctly rejected.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Including the candidate adds a second false alarm in the zero-bias control; six segments remain correctly rejected.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: The finding describes weighting concrete deal-specific objections over abstract cohort data, but no hidden bias mechanism is present in this zero-bias control.
The candidate suggests persistence with a planned launch, but the control manifest contains no hidden instance and the transcript offers legitimate board-timing and rollback-risk explanations.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG explicitly reports that no retrieved corpus passages were supplied and provides no corpus citations. Corpus support therefore does not affect detection scoring.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: No change: both thresholds have 0 false alarms, 8 correct rejections, and undefined hit rate because the control has no positive segments.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: Adding the low-confidence identified finding changes segment false alarms from 0 to 1 and false-alarm rate from 0 to 0.1250; instance-level false positives change from 0 to 1.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Adding the candidate changes segment false alarms from 1 to 2 and false-alarm rate from 0.1250 to 0.2500; instance-level false positives change from 1 to 2.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: Zero-bias control: no qualifying findings at high or moderate confidence; one low-confidence false alarm when all identified confidence levels are included; two false alarms when candidates are also included.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: No hidden instances were detected. Strict instance-level false positives are 0 at high-only and high-and-moderate, 1 with all identified confidence levels, and 2 with candidates included.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Same as strict scoring because neither unsupported finding has a hidden instance or a full mechanism match.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate tier added one plausible but unsupported escalation-of-commitment speculation and no true positive; it increased the segment false-alarm rate from 0.1250 to 0.2500.
main_failure_modes: Low-confidence Salience bias prediction on a negative control segment.
Candidate Escalation of commitment speculation on a negative control segment.
Treating an ambiguous, legitimately motivated trade-off as evidence of a cognitive bias.
main_strengths: Both findings use valid, correctly localized interview evidence.
The RAG marks the salience finding low confidence and keeps the escalation finding at candidate status.
The RAG accurately discloses that no retrieved corpus support was available.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This ambiguous-control run contains zero intentional Herding occurrences. The RAG is conservative at high and moderate confidence, but low-confidence identification and candidate inclusion introduce false alarms without recovering any hidden instance.
